units_default: USDmillions forfinancialamounts; actualpatientcounts anddoses; sharesmillions. Inputmetadata ininputs.json.

outputs.population: End-month disease count; one shared universe, not additive byproduct.
outputs.xr_rx: Prescription attempts this month; can recur after failed access.
outputs.ir_rx: Prescription attempts this month, not necessarily unique cumulative users.
outputs.xr_starts: New paid-access XR cohort activations this month.
outputs.ir_access_starts: New access-approved rescue memberships; dose allocation determines monetized quantity.
outputs.xr_patient_years: Integrated survival exposure before paid-intensity adjustment; post-LOE counterfactual diagnostic.
outputs.ir_member_years: Integrated rescue membership, including potential nondispensers; post-LOE counterfactual.
outputs.xr_active: End-month surviving XR members before generic loss of brandshare.
outputs.ir_access_active: End-month IR access/preference members before generic loss of brandshare.
outputs.overlap_members: Mean-field monthly IR/XR overlap equivalents, within each origin.
outputs.ir_initial_doses: Paid initial therapeutic-dose equivalents; included within first-year budget.
outputs.ir_free_initial_doses: Unpaid initial dose equivalents, no revenue.
outputs.ir_replacement_doses: Paid replacement doses from member-years after initial-stock offset.
outputs.IR_units: Monetized therapeutic doses; after LOE, frozen protected-year anchor times volume erosion.
outputs.XR_units: Monetized paid treatment-years, after intensity and any LOE erosion.
outputs.*_price_usd: Net price per therapeuticdose(IR) or treatmentyear(XR), after LOE price index.
outputs.*_US: US manufacturer net product revenue, USDm.
outputs.*_exUS_endmarket: Foreign demand proxy, USDm; not automatically PHVS revenue.
outputs.*_exUS_direct: Directly recognized foreign product revenue, USDm.
outputs.*_exUS_royalty: PHVS royalty revenue on partner sales, USDm.
outputs.*_recognized: US products plus foreign direct and royalty revenue, USDm.
outputs.revenue: Sum IR and XR recognized revenue; clinical-state conditional.
outputs.rd/commercial/ga/manufacture/license: Economic expense amounts, USDm, positive values.
outputs.operating_income: Revenue less operating expenses and D&A; USDm, can be negative.
outputs.net_income: Operating income less planning tax; forecast excludes interest/FX.
outputs.fcf: Net income plusD&A minuscapex minuschangeNWC; before equityfinancing.
outputs.funding_gross/net/fee: Gross capital, netcashinflow, andtheir difference; USDm, monthend.
outputs.cash_begin/cash_end: Monthly balances, USDm; lastmonth stock in annual/quarterlyoutput.
outputs.distribution: Neither-success liquidation proceeds; USDm, not a recurring dividend.
outputs.cohort_counterfactual_after_loe: True when raw cohortpatient metrics cease to be monetized brandvolumes.
outputs.conditional_peak: Maximum recognizedannualrevenue in explicit forecast assumingbothapprovals.
outputs.IR_free_units: Unpaid initial doses after any post-generic volume erosion; no revenue, but manufacturing cost retained.
